mechanism: Accelerate a wheel from rest while face-supported; store wheel angular momentum.

Try the first face-to-edge rise; subsequent capture/edge-to-vertex is a separate requirement.
The note's instantaneous-lock/fixed-pivot idealization is a conditional comparator, not a valid universal free-contact conservation assumption.

experiment_assumptions.interpretation: Ideal numerical comparison only. Brake torque capacity is I_axis*target_omega/0.005, not a measured brake rating or promised stopping time. Actual simulated stopping time is reported. Do not adopt hardware or increase RPM to force success.
